# Wikipedia fixtures

Saved wikitext is from English Wikipedia and is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike license applicable to Wikipedia text. Each episode fixture has an adjacent JSON file containing its exact permanent revision ID, timestamp and source URL. Research fixtures were fetched on October 18, 2026 through the English Wikipedia revisions API; they are research inputs, not consensus proof or authoritative snapshots of the application.

Sources: Ozymandias (Breaking Bad), Felina (disambiguation, not used by tests), The Mountain and the Viper, War (TV series), VisionQuest and List of Grey's Anatomy episodes. All authors are credited in the linked Wikipedia revision histories. Plot Armor's displayed quotations remain short, attributed and linked to the exact oldid revision.
